title: Integration of ancient DNA with transdisciplinary dataset finds strong support for Inca resettlement in the south Peruvian coast

figures.label: Fig. 1.
figures.title: Fig. 1.
figures.caption: Map showing the locations of the Chincha Valley, the cemeteries under investigation, and other archaeological sites in the Andes that yielded aDNA data cited in this study.
figures.author: Bongers JL, Nakatsuka N, O'Shea C, Harper TK, Tantaleán H, Stanish C, Fehren-Schmitz L.
figures.changes: Complete source image resized where needed and encoded as WebP for display; no crop or panel removal. The unmodified full-resolution image remains at the original source link.

figures.label: Fig. 2.
figures.title: Fig. 2.
figures.caption: Objects from the middle Chincha Valley that appear to be Late Horizon in date and north coast in style or technique: (A) tunic (18.50 × 14.57 inches) from UC-008 Tomb 1 demonstrating a plain weave structure with paired warps and single wefts; (B) a ceramic fragment from UC-008 Tomb 1 that may have been part of a blackware, Chimú-Inca aríbalo (23); (C) a double-bodied, blackware bridge vessel from an adobe chullpa in the UC-044 cemetery; and (D) a blackware vessel from the UC-035 cemetery. Modified from ref. 18.
figures.author: Bongers JL, Nakatsuka N, O'Shea C, Harper TK, Tantaleán H, Stanish C, Fehren-Schmitz L.

figures.label: Fig. 3.
figures.title: Fig. 3.
figures.caption: PCA of ancient individuals projected onto modern indigenous South Americans using the ∼550k SNPs overlapping with the Human Origins set. Modern individuals are unfilled; ancient individuals are filled. Color code is based on the geographic origin of the individuals (see legend).
figures.author: Bongers JL, Nakatsuka N, O'Shea C, Harper TK, Tantaleán H, Stanish C, Fehren-Schmitz L.

figures.label: Fig. 4.
figures.title: Fig. 4.
figures.caption: Neighbor-joining tree based on inverted outgroup-f3 statistics (1/f3[Mbuti; Group1, Group2]) using the 1,240k SNP set. The USA_Ancient_Beringian.SG individual (USA-AK_USR1_Beringian_1140BP.SG) was used as an outgroup for the tree. Only individuals with >25,000 SNPs are included.
figures.author: Bongers JL, Nakatsuka N, O'Shea C, Harper TK, Tantaleán H, Stanish C, Fehren-Schmitz L.

figures.label: Fig. 5.
figures.title: Fig. 5.
figures.caption: Heatmap of outgroup-f3 statistics. Color coding is based on statistics of the form f3(Mbuti; Ancient, Modern), where the ancient groups are (A) Peru_Chincha_UC8_LH, (B) Peru_Chincha_UC12_LH, (C) NorthPeruCoast, (D) CentralPeruCoast, and (E) SouthPeruCoast. Modern individuals are from Barbieri et al. (54).
